Judiciary Calls for More Judges and Better Infrastructure

Chief Justice of India Surya Kant has emphasized the need for enhanced judicial infrastructure and an increase in the number of district court judges. In response, the High Court has established a committee to monitor the expansion of judicial infrastructure. This highlights ongoing efforts to address the judiciary's capacity and efficiency.
